transcript:
**City of Central Falls**
**City Council Meeting**
**1280 High Street**
**Central Falls, RI 02863**
**Thursday, October 15, 2026**
**6:00 p.m.**

## Minutes

Posted: 10/13/2026 Time: 4:15 pm

## I. Roll Call

Council President Pro Tempore Alberto Rivas called the meeting to order at 6:03 p.m. Present were Councilpersons Kazarian, Peguero, Rosado-Martinez, Solano, and Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo. Councilperson Bena arrived at 6:05 p.m. Council President Ferri was absent.

## II. Pledge of Allegiance

Council President Pro Temp Rivas Lugo led the Council in the pledge of allegiance

## III. Public Comment

Mr. Bill Derry of Sylvian Street addressed the Council regarding concerns involving the Central Falls Police Department and a vehicle he had purchased in Florida that was subsequently reported stolen and impounded by the Police Department. Mr. Derry requested assistance from the City Council and the City in resolving the matter and recovering his vehicle or the money he paid for the vehicle.

## IV. Approval of Record

a. Meeting minutes of September 14, 2026, City Council Meeting

*The Council may vote on these items*

Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo asked if any Council members had questions, concerns, or amendments regarding the minutes. Seeing and hearing none, he called for a motion to approve. Councilperson Peguero made a motion to approve the minutes, seconded by Councilperson Solano. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

## V. Executive Communications

a. Consideration of reappointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Alberto Cardona of Providence, to the Juvenile Hearing Board with a term set to expire October 1, 2029

*The Council may vote on this item*

Chief of Staff to Mayor Maria Rivera, Lorraine Quintero, addressed the Council and provided background information regarding the reappointment of Mr. Alberto Cardona's professional experience and qualifications. Councilpersons Rivas Lugo, Peguero, and Kazarian offered welcoming remarks to Mr. Cardona. Councilperson Baena also congratulated Mr. Cardona and asked questions regarding his professional background and proposed title.

b. Consideration of appointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Jessica Crespo of Providence, to the Juvenile Hearing Board with a term set to expire October 1, 2029

*The Council may vote on this item*

Chief of Staff Quintero provided the Council with background information before introducing Ms. Crespo as a new appointee to the Juvenile Hearing Board. Ms. Crespo addressed the Council and responded to questions from Council members. Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo and Councilperson Baena offered their congratulations and expressed their support for the appointment.

Councilperson Rosado-Martinez made a motion to approve the appointment, seconded by Councilperson Baena. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

c. Consideration of appointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Isabella Ribeiro of Central Falls, to the Tree Advisory Board with a term set to expire October 1, 2029

*The Council may vote on this item*

Chief of Staff Quintero provided the Council with an overview of Ms. Ribeiro's background and qualifications before formally introducing her as a new appointee to the Juvenile Hearing Board. Ms. Ribeiro addressed the Council and responded to questions from Council members. Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo and Councilperson Baena welcomed her and expressed their congratulations and support for her appointment.

Councilperson Kazarian moved to approve the appointment, seconded by Councilperson Baena. The motion was unanimously approved, 6-0.

d. Consideration of appointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Lorraine Savard of Central Falls, to the Tree Advisory Board with a term set to expire October 1, 2029

*The Council may vote on this item*

Chief Quintero provided the Council with background information regarding Ms. Savard's qualifications and experience. Ms. Savard addressed the Council and responded to questions from Council members.

Councilperson Baena made a motion to approve the appointment, seconded by Councilperson Rosado-Martinez. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

e. Consideration of appointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Luis Rivera of Central Falls, to the Tree Advisory Board with a term set to expire October 1, 2029

*The Council may vote on this item*

Chief of Staff Lorraine Quintero addressed the Council, provided background information, and introduced Mr. Rivera as a nominee to the Tree Advisory Board. Mr. Rivera responded to questions from Council members regarding his role and responsibilities as a member of the Board.

Councilperson Peguero made a motion to approve the appointment, seconded by Councilperson Baena. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

## VI. Approval of Records

a. Department Financial Reports-September 2026

- i. City Clerk
- ii. Fire Department
- iii. Department of Code Enforcement and Code
- iv. Police Department

Received

## VII. New Business

a. City Council sitting as Board of License Commissioners

Hearing and Consideration of Petition of License

| License Type | Business Name |
|---|---|
| Peddler license New | Michael Calderon, DBA, MC Varieties 26 Joslin Street, Providence, RI 02909 |

*The Council may vote on this item*

The applicant was not present at the meeting. A motion to table the matter until the November meeting was made by Councilperson Baena and seconded by Councilperson Rosado-Martinez. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

## VIII. Schedule of Bills-Hearings and /or Consideration

a. A Resolution of the Central Falls City Council Supporting Local Community Development Block Grant Program (Council President Pro Temp Rivas Lugo, By request)

*The Council may vote on this item*

Planning Director Jim Vandermillen addressed the Council and provided background information regarding the proposed Resolution supporting the Local Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Mr. Vandermillen explained the purpose of the program, outlined the various funding categories available, and discussed the types of community projects and initiatives that may qualify for funding. He discussed the application process, including the steps involved in submitting proposals and the considerations used in determining funding priorities.

Mr. Vandermillen further provided information on the City's plans and priorities for the program and explained how CDBG funding could be used to support local community development efforts and address identified needs within the City.

Councilperson Baena asked questions regarding the available funding amounts, including how funds are allocated among the different categories and the amounts that may be available to support individual projects. Mr. Vandermillen responded to the Council's questions and provided additional clarification regarding the funding process.

Following the discussion, a motion to approve the Resolution was made by Councilperson Solano and seconded by Councilperson Rosado-Martinez. Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo called for a roll-call vote. The votes were as follows: Councilperson Baena, yes; Councilperson Kazarian, yes; Councilperson Peguero, yes; Councilperson Solano, yes; and Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo, yes. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

b. A Resolution Co-naming Illinois Street as "Veterans and First Responders Way" (Council President Ferri)

*The Council may vote on this item*

Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo addressed the Council and provided background information and context regarding the Resolution. Councilperson Baena expressed her support for the proposed Resolution. Following the discussion, a motion to approve the Resolution was made by Councilperson Rosado-Martinez and seconded by Councilperson Peguero.

Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo called for a roll-call vote. The votes were as follows: Councilperson Baena, yes; Councilperson Kazarian, yes; Councilperson Peguero, yes; Councilperson Rosado-Martinez, yes; Councilperson Solano, yes; and Council President Pro Tempore Rivas Lugo, yes. The motion passed unanimously, 6-0.

## IX. Adjournment

A motion to adjourn was made by councilperson Peguero and Seconded by Councilperson Solano. Meeting adjourned at 6:42pm
